blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by enabling non-autoregressive text generation. However, their practical deployment remains limited by inefficient inference, largely due to the absence of effective Key-Value (KV) caching and scalable parallel decoding mechanisms. Existing acceleration methods typically study KV caching and parallel decoding in isolation, overlooking the I/O bottlenecks that arise when cache reuse and parallel token verification are jointly applied. In this work, we introduce Flash-dLLM , a training-free inference acceleration framework for fast and memory-efficient dLLMs. Flash-dLLM first identifies GPU memory I/O as a dominant bottleneck in KV-cache-enabled dLLM inference and addresses it with an I/O-aware fused KV-cache kernel that reduces redundant memory movement. Building on this optimized cache mechanism, Flash-dLLM further proposes an efficient KV-cache-driven draft-and-verify decoding strategy, where the dLLM itself serves as both drafter and verifier without requiring an auxiliary model. This unified design enables faster decoding while preserving generation quality and improving scalability to longer sequences and larger batch size. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that Flash-dLLM consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art dLLM acceleration methods in both inference speed and memory efficiency. In particular, it achieves 5.1 × 5.1\times and 11.0 × 11.0\times speedups over prior strongest baseline Elastic-Cache on GSM8K and HumanEval, respectively.
blocks.zh: 扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)最近出现,作为可实现非自发文本生成的自递性LLMs的有希望的替代. 然而,由于推论效率低下,主要由于缺乏有效的Key-Value(KV)缓存和可伸缩的平行解码机制,其实际部署仍然受到限制。 现有的加速方法通常孤立地研究KV缓存和平行解码,而忽略了当缓存再利用和平行符号验证联合应用时出现的I/O瓶颈. 在这部作品中,我们引入了Flash-dLLM,这是一个快速和内存高效的DLLM的无训练推论加速框架. Flash-dLLM首先将GPU内存I/O识别为KV-cache-uplied dLLM推论中的主要瓶颈,并用一个I/O-aware被熔化了的KV-cache内核进行处理,减少冗余内存运动. 基于这一优化的缓存机制,Flash-dLLM还进一步提出了高效的KV-cache驱动的草稿和验证解码策略,其中dLLLM本身既充当了起草者,也充当了核查者,而不需要辅助模型. 这种统一设计能够更快地进行解码,同时保持出产质量,并提升可扩展性以达到更长的序列和更大的批量尺寸. 关于数学推理和代码生成基准的广泛实验表明,Flash-dLLM在推论速度和内存效率方面始终比现有最先进的dLLM加速方法要好. 特别是,它在GSM8K和HumanEval上分别实现了5.1×5.1\时和11.0×11.0\时比前最强基线弹性-卡切快.

blocks.en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) Austin et al. (2021a) ; Sahoo et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Bie et al. (2025) ; Nie et al. (2025b) ; Ye et al. (2025a) ; Ou et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025b) ; Shi et al. (2024) ; Google DeepMind (2025) ; Inception Labs (2025) ; Arriola et al. (2025) ; Lou et al. (2023) ; Nie et al. (2025a) ; Xie et al. (2025) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive large language models Radford et al. (2018) ; Achiam et al. (2023) ; Singh et al. (2025) ; Comanici et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025a) by reformulating text generation as an iterative denoising process. Instead of producing tokens strictly from left to right, dLLMs refine partially masked or noisy sequences over multiple denoising steps, enabling more flexible generation schedules and exposing opportunities for non-autoregressive decoding. This paradigm has shown encouraging potential for controllable generation, global sequence refinement, and improved parallelism. However, despite these algorithmic advantages, the practical inference efficiency of open-source dLLMs still lags behind mature autoregressive LLM systems, whose deployment has benefited from years of optimization around KV caching, attention kernels, and speculative decoding Kwon et al. (2023) ; Ye et al. (2025b) ; Cai et al. (2024) ; Pope et al. (2023) .

blocks.en: A major bottleneck to efficient dLLM inference lies in the repeated construction and movement of Key-Value (KV) states across denoising iterations. In autoregressive LLMs, KV caching avoids recomputing attention states for previously generated tokens. In dLLMs, however, the sequence is repeatedly revisited, and the set of updated tokens changes across iterations. This causes frequent KV-cache reads, writes, and updates Liu et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2026) ; Ma et al. (2025b) , even when many cached states remain unchanged or contribute little to the current decoding step. As a result, naive KV caching may reduce floating-point computation but introduce substantial GPU memory-access overhead. In practice, the redundancy in KV-cache read and write operations can dominate runtime, limiting the actual speedup obtainable from cache reuse (Fig. 1(a) ).
blocks.zh: 高效 dLLM 推论的一个主要瓶颈在于Key-Value(KV)状态反复地构建和移动,跨越了断代. 在自递回式LLMs中,KV缓存可以避免对先前生成的令牌重新计算注意力状态. 然而,在dLLMs中,序列反复被重审,而一组更新的代号会在整个迭代中发生变化. 这使得KV-cache频繁地读取,写出并更新了"刘等"(2025年);"宋等"(2026年);"马等"(2025年b),即使许多被缓存的状态没有改变或对目前的解码步骤贡献不大. 因此,天真的KV缓存可能会减少浮点计算,但会引入大量的GPU内存访问高通. 在实践中,KV-cache读写操作中的冗余可以主导运行时间,限制了从缓存再利用(图1 (a))中获得的实际速度.

blocks.en: Beyond this system-level redundancy, dLLM decoding also exhibits strong token-level sparsity. Although each denoising step processes the full sequence, only a small fraction of decoded or partially decoded tokens has a significant influence on the current prediction distribution. Many tokens remain stable across iterations or provide limited additional context for the next decoding decision. Treating all cached tokens as equally important therefore wastes memory bandwidth and computation Song et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2023) ; Xiao et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2024) . This observation suggests that efficient dLLM inference should not simply cache and reuse all KV states uniformly, instead, it should prioritize the subset of tokens that meaningfully affect the current decoding process while reducing unnecessary memory traffic for less influential tokens (Fig. 1(b) ).
blocks.zh: 除了这种系统级冗余外,dLLM解码还表现出强烈的符号级相接性. 虽然每个去名步骤都会处理完整序列,但只有一小部分被去名或部分去名代号对当前预测分布有重大影响. 许多信使在整个重复中保持稳定,或者为下一个解码决定提供了有限的额外上下文. 因此,将所有缓存的代币视为同样重要,因此,浪费记忆带宽并计算出宋等(2026);黄等(2026);张等(2023);萧等(2024);唐等(2024)。 这一观察表明,高效的dLLM推论不应该简单地缓存和再利用所有KV状态,相反,它应该优先处理有意义地影响当前解码进程的子集,同时减少影响较小的符号(图1(b))不必要的内存流量.

blocks.en: Another key point comes from the confidence dynamics of dLLM generation Wei et al. (2025) ; Kong et al. (2025) ; Israel et al. (2025) ; Wu et al. (2026b) . During iterative denoising, many tokens become semantically determined at an early stage, even though their individual confidence scores may not yet exceed the conservative threshold required for immediate commitment. These tokens are often close to being correctly decoded, but existing decoding strategies delay their acceptance until later iterations, leading to redundant refinement steps. This creates a mismatch between token readiness and token commitment: the model already contains sufficient information to recover many positions, yet the decoding algorithm fails to exploit this early predictability due to insufficient confidence calibration.
blocks.zh: 另一个关键点来自dLLM一代魏等(2025年);孔等(2025年);以色等(2025年);吴等(2026年b)的信心动态. 在迭代解密期间,许多信使在早期阶段就变得具有象征意义,尽管其个人信心分数可能尚未超过立即承诺所需的保守门槛。 这些道具往往接近被正确解码,但已存在的解码策略会将接受延迟到后期迭代,导致冗余的完善步骤. 这造成了象征准备和象征承诺之间的不匹配:模型已经包含足够的信息来恢复许多位置,而解码算法由于信心校正不足而未能利用这种早期的可预测性.

blocks.en: Importantly, we observe that increasing the average confidence level of candidate decoded tokens directly improves the number of tokens that can be accepted correctly in each denoising step (Fig. 1(c) ). This indicates that the bottleneck is not only whether tokens can be predicted early, but whether their confidence can be made reliable enough for safe parallel commitment. A more effective decoding strategy should therefore aggregate useful contextual evidence, suppress low-impact cache interactions, and raise the confidence of promising token candidates. By doing so, dLLMs can decode more tokens per iteration while preserving generation quality, thereby reducing the total number of denoising steps required for completion.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,我们认为,提高候选人解码信使的平均信任水平直接改善了每个解码步骤中能够正确接受信使的数量(图1(c))。 这表明,瓶颈不仅在于是否能够及早预测到信物,而且在于它们的信心是否能够变得足够可靠,以便安全地作出平行承诺。 因此,更有效的编码战略应汇集有用的背景证据,抑制低影响缓存互动,并增强有希望的象征性候选人的信心。 通过这样做,dLLMs可以解码每个迭代更多的代号,同时保持生成质量,从而减少完成所需的去名步骤的总数.

blocks.en: Motivated by these observations, we propose Flash-dLLM , a training-free inference framework that jointly optimizes IO-aware KV caching and cache-driven parallel decoding for fast, memory-efficient dLLMs. Flash-dLLM first reduces redundant KV-cache memory movement through an IO-aware fused cache kernel, which minimizes unnecessary read/write operations and improves cache locality during iterative denoising. It then exploits token-level sparsity by focusing cache reuse and verification on tokens that most affect the current decoding step. Finally, Flash-dLLM introduces a KV-cache-based parallel draft-and-verify mechanism that enables the dLLM itself to draft multiple early-decodable tokens and verify them with improved confidence, without requiring an auxiliary drafter or additional training. Together, these designs convert the inherent parallelism of diffusion language generation into practical wall-clock acceleration and improved memory scalability.
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们提议Flash-dLLM, 一个训练无阻推论框架, 联合优化 IO-aware KV 缓存和缓存驱动的并行解码,用于快速,内存高效的 DLLMs. Flash-dLLM首先通过IO-aware的被熔接的缓存内核来减少冗余的KV-cache内存运动,这可以将不必要的读取/写入操作最小化,并在迭代去诺时改进缓存位置. 然后它通过将缓存再利用和校验重点放在最能影响当前解码步骤的符号上,从而利用了符号级的垃圾. 最后,Flash-dLLM引入了以KV-cache为基础的并行的草稿与验证机制,使dLLM本身能够起草多个早期可解码符并用更自信的方式加以验证,而不需要辅助的起草者或额外的训练. 这些设计一起将传播语言生成的内在并行性转化为实用的相扑时速加速并改进了内存可扩展性.

blocks.en: This study makes the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 这项研究做出了以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We identify redundant read/write memory access as a key bottleneck in KV-cache-enabled dLLM inference, and propose an IO-aware fused KV-cache mechanism to reduce unnecessary GPU memory movement and improve cache locality. We further observe that only a small subset of decoded tokens significantly affects the current decoding step. Based on this, Flash-dLLM selectively prioritizes influential tokens during cache reuse and verification, improving efficiency without uniformly processing all cached states. • We propose a training-free parallel decoding strategy where the dLLM itself serves as both drafter and verifier. By leveraging cached states to increase candidate-token confidence, Flash-dLLM enables more tokens to be decoded correctly in early stages, reducing denoising steps while preserving generation quality. • Our approach achieves strong empirical speed and scalability gains. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed Flash-dLLM improves inference speed and memory efficiency while maintaining generation quality, outperforming existing dLLM acceleration methods.

blocks.en: Flash-Cache consists of three main components: (i) a fused kernel for Key-Value (KV) caching to alleviate the IO bottleneck, (ii) scheduled flash attention to manage the substantial variation in sequence lengths within batches, and (iii) constrained cache updates by monitoring the most-attended tokens.
blocks.zh: Flash-Cache由三个主要部分组成:(一) 为Key-Value (KV) 缓存提供引信内核以缓解IO瓶颈,(二) 定期的闪存注意力来管理分批内序列长度的巨大变化,(三) 通过监控最受关注的符号来限制缓存更新.

blocks.en: At each transformer layer, a conventional KV cache implementation launches four separate CUDA kernels for the query set 𝒬 t \mathcal{Q}^{t} : QKV projection, rotary positional embedding (RoPE), cache write, and attention. Each kernel writes its output to GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) before the next kernel reads it. QKV projection, RoPE, and cache writing each incur 𝒪 ⁡ ( Q ​ d model ) \mathcal{O}(Qd_{\text{model}}) memory traffic, while attention streams over the full cache with 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ d ) \mathcal{O}(Nd) traffic. Thus, the total per-layer HBM traffic is approximately 4 × 𝒪 ⁡ ( Q ​ d model ) + 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ d ) 4\times\mathcal{O}(Qd_{\text{model}})+\mathcal{O}(Nd) . Because the non-attention operations have low arithmetic intensity, the cache-update path becomes memory-bound (Fig. 3(a) ).

blocks.en: Inspired by Flash Attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) , we introduce a fused Flash-Cache kernel that combines QKV projection, RoPE, and cache writing (Fig. 3(a) ). The fused kernel performs projection and RoPE in SRAM and writes the resulting keys and values directly to the KV cache, eliminating intermediate key-value materialization. This reduces HBM traffic, lowers memory usage, and improves IO efficiency. As shown in Fig. 1(a) , positional embedding and cache writing can dominate runtime relative to core computations such as attention and QKV projection. With Flash-Cache, we achieve a 1.37 × 1.37\times speedup on an RTX 3090 GPU.
blocks.zh: 在闪光关注(Dao等,2022年)的启发下,我们引入了将QKV投影,ROPE和缓存写入(图3(a))相结合的被熔化的闪光-卡切内核. 被引信内核在SRAM中执行投影和ROPE,并将所生成的密钥和值直接写入KV缓存,去除中间密钥-值可实现. 这降低了HBM的流量,降低了内存的使用,提高了IO的效率. 如图1 (a)所示,相对于关注和QKV预测等核心计算,位置嵌入和缓存写入可以主导运行时间. 与Flash-Cache相接,在RTX 3090 GPU上实现1.37×1.37\时速加速.

blocks.en: KV caching and parallel decoding introduce new challenges for scaling diffusion LLMs to batched inference. While conventional attention can process variable-length sequences through padding and length-based grouping, diffusion LLMs make sequence lengths more dynamic and divergent. KV caching typically alternates between a caching stage, which computes only over a small window, and an update stage, which recomputes the full sequence; as a result, samples in the same batch may require substantially different computation at each iteration. Forcing all samples into the same stage can reduce efficiency and accuracy. This issue is further amplified by adaptive methods such as Elastic-Cache, where sequence length may vary within a layer, and by parallel decoding, which causes samples to progress at different rates.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we extend Flash Attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Shah et al., 2024 ; Zadouri et al., 2026 ) by partitioning each batch into multiple sequence blocks and scheduling them with a block table that aligns query blocks with their corresponding key-value blocks (Fig. 3(b) ). This design mitigates length discrepancies during inference and provides a flexible mechanism for adding or removing blocks, enabling more adaptive decisions about when to cache or update. Unlike Flash Attention, which primarily optimizes IO efficiency within the attention computation, our Scheduled Flash Attention focuses on controlling which blocks are computed and in what order through the block table. This scheduling strategy is particularly effective for accelerating batched inference in diffusion LLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们提供了闪光关注(Dao等人,2022年;Shah等人,2024年;Zadouri等人,2026年),将每批分出多个序列区块,并用一个区块表排列它们,使查询区块与相应的关键值区块相匹配(图3(b))。 这种设计减轻了推断时的长度差异,为添加或去除块提供了灵活的机制,使得能对何时缓存或更新作出更适应性的决定. 与Flash Reference(主要优化了注意力计算中的IO效率)不同,我们的"排程"Flash Reference(英语:Flash Reference)侧重于通过块表来控制哪些块被计算,以及按什么顺序被计算. 这一时间安排战略对于加快分批推论传播有限责任公司特别有效。

We observed that only 32 of the top-attended tokens can contribute approximately 50% of the weight in attention computation among the middle layers (from layer 5 to 20, as shown in Fig. 1(b) ). blocks.en: Confidence-aware decoding ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026a ) unmasks only tokens whose confidence c i = max x ⁡ p θ ​ ( x i ∣ 𝐱 t ) c^{i}=\max_{x}p_{\theta}(x^{i}\mid\mathbf{x}_{t}) exceeds a threshold ϵ \epsilon , discarding all others even when many are correct (Fig. 1(c) ). This creates a throughput ceiling on tasks where the model is uncertain, as few tokens pass the threshold per step. We propose Flash-Verify, a self-verification scheme in which the dLLM serves as both drafter and verifier, recovering correct predictions that confidence-aware decoding would waste. At each denoising step, a standard draft pass runs the model on 𝒬 t = 𝒯 t ∪ ℳ β m t \mathcal{Q}^{t}=\mathcal{T}^{t}\cup\mathcal{M}^{t}_{\beta_{m}} against the full KV cache. blocks.en: Implementation Details. All experiments run on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU. We evaluate Flash-dLLM on LLaDA-1.5 ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) across GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021b ) . We implement the fused KV-cache kernel in Triton 2.0. Default benchmark is GSM8K, with default hyperparameters: confidence threshold ϵ = 0.9 \epsilon=0.9 , verify threshold γ = 0.8 \gamma=0.8 , block size β = 16 \beta=16 , tracked budget β t = 80 \beta_{t}=80 , sliding window size β m = 64 \beta_{m}=64 , generation length 512. For fair comparison, we re-run all baselines under identical hardware and software configurations. Baselines. We compare against three approaches: (1) No Cache : standard dLLM inference without KV caching, under both greedy (fixed-step) and confidence-aware decoding; (2) Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) : prefix-caching with confidence-aware decoding; (3) Elastic-Cache ( Nguyen-Tri et al., 2025 ) : adaptive KV caching with attention-pattern-based cache reuse. We report Flash-dLLM results under three configurations: greedy decoding (pure KV-cache speedup), confidence-aware decoding (KV-cache + parallel decoding), and Flash-Verify (KV-cache + draft-and-verify parallel decoding).

blocks.en: Throughput. Flash-Cache substantially accelerates greedy decoding, yielding speedups of 8.0 × 8.0\times – 58.5 × 58.5\times . Under confidence-aware decoding, the range increases to 17.0 × 17.0\times – 102.2 × 102.2\times , indicating that cache acceleration remains effective with parallel decoding. Combining Flash-Verify and Flash-Cache achieves the highest throughput in all eight settings, reaching 148.0 148.0 – 210.6 210.6 tokens/s and speedups of 22.3 × 22.3\times – 148.2 × 148.2\times . Relative to confidence-aware Flash-Cache, the second-fastest configuration throughout, it improves throughput by approximately 23.5 % 23.5\% – 45.0 % 45.0\% . The gains are larger at longer generation lengths: from 256 to 512 tokens, the speedup increases from 29.1 × 29.1\times to 81.0 × 81.0\times on GSM8K, 22.3 × 22.3\times to 42.0 × 42.0\times on MATH, 29.9 × 29.9\times to 58.0 × 58.0\times on HumanEval, and 61.7 × 61.7\times to 148.2 × 148.2\times on MBPP.

Accuracy. Accuracy exhibits a task-dependent trade-off. On GSM8K-512, Flash-Verify with Flash-Cache achieves both the highest accuracy ( 83.02 % 83.02\% ) and throughput ( 210.6 210.6 tokens/s). Elsewhere, the fastest configuration is not consistently the most accurate: Flash-Verify without caching performs best on GSM8K-256 and MATH-512, whereas confidence-aware Flash-Cache leads on HumanEval-512 and both MBPP settings. On mathematical reasoning tasks, the combined method remains within 1.78 1.78 percentage points of the best accuracy. Larger gaps arise for 256-token code generation, reaching 3.66 3.66 points on HumanEval and 3.60 3.60 points on MBPP. Overall, Flash-Verify with Flash-Cache provides the strongest throughput-oriented configuration.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion Language Models and Acceleration. Masked diffusion models generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens predicted in parallel ( Li et al., 2025b ; Austin et al., 2021a ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Scaling this paradigm has produced models competitive with autoregressive LLMs, including LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025b ) , Dream ( Ye et al., 2025a ) , and Gemini Diffusion ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) . However, the lack of KV caching support makes dLLM inference slow: bidirectional attention and evolving hidden states across denoising steps prevent direct reuse of autoregressive caching strategies ( Pope et al., 2023 ) . Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) introduces prefix caching with confidence-aware decoding. dKV-Cache ( Ma et al., 2025a ) caches at fixed temporal intervals. Elastic-Cache ( Nguyen-Tri et al., 2025 ) makes updates adaptive via attention-pattern drift detection. FlashDLM ( Hu et al., 2025 ) combines token-level change detection with an external autoregressive verifier.

blocks.en: Parallel Decoding and Speculative Verification. Speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) accelerates autoregressive LLMs by drafting tokens with a fast model and verifying them in parallel with the target model. In diffusion LLMs, parallel decoding takes a different form: confidence-aware methods ( Wu et al., 2025 ) unmask all tokens above a threshold per step, Prophet ( Li et al., 2025a ) dynamically halts refinement when predictions stabilize, and FreeDave ( Wu and Zhang, 2025 ) drafts tokens in one forward pass then verifies in a second. FlashDLM ( Hu et al., 2025 ) uses an external autoregressive LLM as the verifier. Our Flash-Verify differs from all of these: the dLLM serves as both drafter and verifier through the KV cache, with no external model and no training. We feed both the draft predictions and the original masks at the same positions under a causal attention mask, letting the model check its own consistency in a single additional forward pass. Tokens are accepted only when the draft and mask views agree, combining the throughput of aggressive parallel decoding with the accuracy of conservative single-token unmasking.
blocks.zh: 平行解码和分镜核查。 分谱解码(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023)通过用快取模型来起草代币并和目标模型并行验证来加速自旋LLMS. 在扩散LLMS中,平行解码有不同的形式:信心感知方法(Wu等,2025年)将所有超过每步阈值的符号都解析出;先知(Li等,2025年a)在预测稳定时动态地停止了完善;FreeDave(Wu和Zhang,2025年)在前方一地起草符号后再在一地验证. FlashDLM(Hu等,2025年)使用外自旋LLM作为验证器. 我们的Flash-Verify与所有这些不同:dLLM通过KV缓存同时担任起草者和核查者,没有外部模型,也没有训练. 我们把预测草稿和原始口罩都装入同一位置的因果注意口罩中,让模型在一次额外的前行通道中检查其自身的一致性. 只有在草案和口罩观点达成一致时才接受托肯语,将侵略性平行解码的吞吐量与保守的单托肯解码的准确性结合起来.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed Flash-dLLM , a training-free inference acceleration framework for diffusion Large Language Models. Flash-dLLM addresses the key efficiency bottlenecks in dLLM decoding by jointly handling IO-aware KV caching and parallel draft-and-verify decoding. By reducing redundant KV-cache read/write operations, prioritizing influential decoded tokens, and improving the confidence of early token commitments, Flash-dLLM effectively converts the inherent parallelism of dLLMs into practical inference speedup. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that Flash-dLLM achieves superior speed, memory efficiency, and scalability over existing acceleration methods, offering a promising and practical path toward efficient deployment of diffusion-based language models.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了Flash-dLLM(英语:Flash-dLLM),即推广大语言模型的无训练推论加速框架. Flash-dLLM通过联合处理IO-aware KV缓存和平行的草稿与验证解码,解决dLLM解码中的关键效率瓶颈. Flash-dLLM通过减少冗余的KV-cache读取/写入操作,优先处理有影响力的解码符,并增强早期符号承诺的信心等,将dLLM的内在并行性有效转换为实用推论速度. 关于数学推理和代码生成的广泛实验表明,Flash-dLLM实现了优于现有加速方法的速度,内存效率和可伸缩性,为高效地部署以扩散为基础的语言模型提供了一条有希望和实用的途径.

blocks.en: Flash-dLLM is evaluated on two representative masked diffusion LLMs across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. While the fused Triton kernel and Flash-Verify are architecture-agnostic in design, we have not yet validated them on continuous-space diffusion language models, where the cache update patterns may differ. Similarly, our benchmarks focus on structured-output tasks; the behavior of confidence-aware decoding on open-ended generation (e.g., long-form writing or dialogue), where token-level confidence distributions tend to be flatter, is an interesting direction for future work. The hyperparameters γ \gamma and β m \beta_{m} are fixed throughout generation; an adaptive scheme that adjusts these based on running confidence statistics could further improve the throughput-accuracy trade-off. We view these as natural extensions and a potential future research direction.
blocks.zh: Flash-dLLM通过数学推理和代码生成任务对两个具有代表性的蒙面扩散LLMs进行评估. 虽然被熔化的Triton内核和Flash-Verify在设计上是架构-不可知性的,但我们还没有在连续空间扩散语言模型上验证它们,其中缓存更新模式可能有所不同. 同样,我们的基准侧重于结构化的输出任务;对不限成员名额的一代(如:长式写作或对话)进行信心意识解码的行为,而象征性的信任分配往往受到赞扬,这是未来工作的有趣方向。 高参数 γ\gamma和β m\beta_{m}是固定在一代人的身上的;根据运行中的信心统计来调整这些参数的适应性计划可以进一步改善吞吐量-准确性权衡. 我们认为这些是自然延伸和今后可能的研究方向。

blocks.en: B Broader Impact
blocks.zh: B. 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work targets inference-time efficiency for diffusion LLMs and does not introduce new training data, model architectures, or fine-tuning procedures. By reducing the computational and memory cost of dLLM decoding, Flash-dLLM lowers the hardware barrier to deploying these models, which could broaden access to non-autoregressive language generation for researchers and practitioners with limited GPU resources. Faster inference also reduces the energy consumption per generated sequence, contributing to more sustainable deployment of large language models. We do not modify safety filters or alignment mechanisms of the underlying models; the generation quality and any associated risks (e.g., producing harmful or biased content) are inherited from the base dLLM. We encourage users to apply standard content moderation and human oversight when deploying Flash-dLLM in user-facing applications, particularly in high-stakes domains.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的目标是推广LLMS的推断时间效率,没有引入新的培训数据、模型架构或微调程序。 通过降低dLLM解码的计算和内存成本,Flash-dLLM降低了部署这些模型的硬件屏障,这可以使GPU资源有限的研究人员和从业者拓宽非自发性语言生成的通道. 更快的推论还降低了每个生成序列的能耗,有助于更可持续地部署大型语言模型. 我们不修改基本模型的安全过滤器或校正机制;生成质量和任何相关风险(如产生有害或有偏见的内容)都从基础dLLLM中继承. 我们鼓励用户在用户软件中应用Flash-dLLM时应用标准内容节制和人类监督,特别是在高吸管领域。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. All experiments run on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU. We evaluate Flash-dLLM on LLaDA-1.5 [ 59 ] across GSM8K [ 11 ] , MATH [ 17 ] , HumanEval [ 10 ] , and MBPP [ 5 ] . We implement the fused KV-cache kernel in Triton 2.0. Default benchmark is GSM8K, with default hyperparameters: confidence threshold ϵ = 0.9 \epsilon=0.9 , verify threshold γ = 0.8 \gamma=0.8 , block size β = 16 \beta=16 , tracked budget β t = 80 \beta_{t}=80 , sliding window size β m = 64 \beta_{m}=64 , generation length 512. For fair comparison, we re-run all baselines under identical hardware and software configurations. Baselines. We compare against three approaches: (1) No Cache : standard dLLM inference without KV caching, under both greedy (fixed-step) and confidence-aware decoding; (2) Fast-dLLM [ 46 ] : prefix-caching with confidence-aware decoding; (3) Elastic-Cache [ 31 ] : adaptive KV caching with attention-pattern-based cache reuse. We report Flash-dLLM results under three configurations: greedy decoding (pure KV-cache speedup), confidence-aware decoding (KV-cache + parallel decoding), and Flash-Verify (KV-cache + draft-and-verify parallel decoding). Evaluation Metrics. We use lm-eval-harness [ 14 ] . Throughput is measured as decoding tokens/sec averaged over the benchmark, following Fast-dLLM’s protocol [ 46 ] . Accuracy metrics: GSM8K uses 5-shot flexible_extract ; MATH uses 4-shot math_verify ; HumanEval uses 0-shot pass@1 with Fast-dLLM post-processing; MBPP uses 3-shot pass@1 . We test at generation lengths 256 and 512 to study scalability.

blocks.en: Evaluation Framework and Metrics. Our evaluation protocol comprehensively assesses both inference efficiency and model performance across various tasks. To ensure standardization and reproducibility, we conduct all task-specific evaluations using the lm-eval-harness library [ 14 ] . Inference speed is measured by throughput in tokens per second (t/s), calculated as the average number of tokens generated by the model over the entire sequence until it produces an end-of-sequence ( <eos> ) token. We maintain consistency with Fast-dLLM [ 46 ] in our calculation methodology to ensure comparable speed benchmarks. Task-specific performance is evaluated using established metrics suitable for each benchmark. For GSM8K [ 11 ] , we report 5-shot flexible_extract exact match accuracy. For the MATH dataset [ 17 ] , we report the 4-shot math_verify score using the minerva_math variant. For HumanEval [ 10 ] , we evaluate 0-shot accuracy using a post-processing script consistent with the Fast-dLLM implementation to ensure fair comparison. Finally, for MBPP [ 5 ] , we report the 3-shot pass@1 metric.

blocks.en: Table 5 examines the sensitivity of the two decoding strategies to generation length and prefill length. As shown in Table 5(a) , Flash-Cache with Flash-Verify consistently provides higher throughput than confidence-aware decoding across all generation lengths. Its throughput advantage ranges from 1.38 × 1.38\times to 1.41 × 1.41\times , corresponding to absolute improvements of 47.3 47.3 – 58.0 58.0 tokens/s. Both methods reach their highest throughput at a generation length of 256, attaining 140.4 140.4 tokens/s for confidence-aware decoding and 198.4 198.4 tokens/s for Flash-Verify. Beyond 256 tokens, throughput gradually decreases, while accuracy remains nearly unchanged. For example, increasing the generation length from 256 to 1024 reduces throughput by approximately 10.5 % 10.5\% for confidence-aware decoding and 12.8 % 12.8\% for Flash-Verify, without providing a corresponding accuracy improvement.

blocks.en: Table 5(b) shows that increasing the number of in-context examples, and consequently the prefill length, reduces throughput for both methods. From 1-shot to 8-shot prompting, confidence-aware throughput decreases from 155.8 155.8 to 123.1 123.1 tokens/s, a reduction of approximately 21.0 % 21.0\% . Flash-Verify decreases from 234.4 234.4 to 165.7 165.7 tokens/s, corresponding to a reduction of approximately 29.3 % 29.3\% . blocks.en: Flash-Verify achieves the highest throughput at every batch size. Relative to greedy decoding under the same batch configuration, its speedup increases from 3.0 × 3.0\times at B = 1 B=1 to approximately 3.6 × 3.6\times for B ≥ 8 B\geq 8 . Confidence-aware decoding provides a smaller speedup of approximately 2.5 × 2.5\times – 2.8 × 2.8\times . The advantage of Flash-Verify over confidence-aware decoding also grows with batch size: it is only 8.3 % 8.3\% faster at B = 1 B=1 , but becomes approximately 43.2 % 43.2\% faster at B = 32 B=32 . This trend indicates that Flash-Verify makes more effective use of the additional parallel computation available at larger batch sizes.
